keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Monterrey 0, Club Tijuana 1. Jackson Porozo (Club Tijuana) header from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Francisco González with a cross following a corner.
Carlos Salcedo (Monterrey) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Monterrey 1, Club Tijuana 1. Hugo Cuypers (Monterrey) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the centre of the goal.
Delay in match because of an injury Esteban Andrada (Monterrey).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Monterrey 2, Club Tijuana 1. Hugo Cuypers (Monterrey) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Ricardo Chávez.
Goal! Monterrey 2, Club Tijuana 2. Adonis Preciado (Club Tijuana) header from very close range to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Rafael Fernández with a cross.
First Half ends, Monterrey 2, Club Tijuana 2.
Substitution, Club Tijuana. Gilberto Mora replaces Ramiro Árciga.
Substitution, Club Tijuana. Pablo Ortíz replaces Alan Vega.
Second Half begins Monterrey 2, Club Tijuana 2.
Óliver Torres (Monterrey) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Monterrey 3, Club Tijuana 2. Lucas Ocampos (Monterrey) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Óliver Torres with a cross.

Goal! Monterrey 3, Club Tijuana 3. Adonis Preciado (Club Tijuana) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Ignacio Rivero with a through ball following a fast break.
Substitution, Monterrey. Aldo de Nigris replaces Jesús Corona.
Ignacio Rivero (Club Tijuana) is shown the yellow card.
Adonis Preciado (Club Tijuana) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Club Tijuana. Yael Padilla replaces Adonis Preciado.
Elias Manoel (Tijuana) Substitution at 70'
Delay in match because of an injury Ignacio Rivero (Club Tijuana).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Club Tijuana. Joban González replaces Francisco González.
Delay in match because of an injury Iván Tona (Club Tijuana).
Ricardo Chávez (Monterrey) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Monterrey. Luca Orellano replaces Lucas Ocampos.
Substitution, Monterrey. Stefan Medina replaces Víctor Guzmán.
Substitution, Monterrey. Érick Aguirre replaces Ricardo Chávez.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
